The Kowalski Family | Krakow, Poland
August 2026 Update

Dear friends,

Ministry here continues to grow -- our young adult discipleship group now has fifteen regulars, up from four last year.

We do have one specific need this month: our apartment's heating system failed inspection and must be replaced before winter. The contractor's quote is 8,400 Polish zloty, which comes to about $2,100 USD. We'd be grateful for any help covering this before the cold sets in.

Please also pray for our visa renewal appointment next month -- paperwork delays have been common lately and we'd love a smooth process.

Thank you for partnering with us,
Tomasz and Hanna Kowalski
